copy.title: Validated, Not Yet Queued
copy.headline: How long has each ticket sat after its PR was validated?
copy.lede: Every open issue whose pull request has been reviewed and validated but which has not yet moved on to the QA queue. Aged from the moment it last moved into PR Validated.
copy.chart_title: Distribution of time since PR validation
notes: **This is a hand-off step, so it should stay nearly empty.** PR Validated sits between peer review and Ready for QA, so a ticket resting here is waiting on a status move rather than on work. Anything with real age is more likely a bookkeeping gap than a genuine bottleneck, so check the board before reading it as a delay.
